body.heading: Watch the clouds
paragraphs: Lie on the blanket or sit at the window with your adult. Choose one cloud and watch it slowly change.
Clouds never hurry. Give yours time to become something.

body.heading: Draw your creature
paragraphs: When your cloud looks like a creature, draw it quickly before it changes its mind.
Add the creature's face and give it a name. Cloud creatures love having names.

takeaway: A cloud can be a dragon for one minute and a ship the next.
materials: A blanket or a window seat
safetyNotes: Cloud watching is for lying back or sitting safely with your adult; never look directly at the Sun.
screenFreeExtension: Invent a name and a story for your favourite cloud creature.
